messages:
maya: Creating RC from main -> candidate v1.14.0-rc1. Artifact sha: abcdef123456. Requesting signoff + quiet window 22:00-23:00 UTC. Release notes PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-notes/pull/412 — please skim
jamal: LGTM on release notes, left one nit about upgrade note.
sara: ran test matrix, found intermittent embed-encoder timeout on linux-x64. Repro steps in #qa. Need ~1h bake in staging before promo.
luca: propose canary plan: pin kube tag 'v1.14.0-rc1', 10% for 30m then 50% for 15m. Will monitor error-rate/dashboard.
maya: pin works for me, added rollback stub in release notes.
deploybot: preflight checks: artifact exists, infra templates lint OK, smoke-tests queued.
deploybot: smoke-tests result: PASS (smoke: 5/5). Canary job created: canary-id=cb-2839.
ops-bot: runbook snapshot attached: /runbooks/rc-promo.json — ensure alerting is active and escalation set.
sara: QA signoff after staging bake :white_check_mark: — encoder flake noted but not blocking for this RC.
luca: SRE signoff. I'll be oncall for the promo window and watch latency + 5xx.
maya: Approving promotion. Who will sheriff first 30m?
oncall_tina: I'll sheriff first 30m then hand to luca.
jamal: note: DB migration job M2026-14 runs at 22:15 UTC; recommend scheduling promo after it finishes.
maya: OK moved quiet window to 23:00-00:00 UTC to avoid migration overlap. deploybot, schedule promo at 23:10 UTC.
deploybot: scheduling promo for 23:10 UTC. Canary plan: 10% for 30m -> 50% for 15m -> 100% for 10m. Auto-rollback rule: error-rate > 3x baseline for 5m.
luca: rollback command (handy):
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/api --to-revision=stable-2026-03-19
```
jamal: pinned artifact in release config: tag=v1.14.0-rc1 sha=abcdef123456.
sara: updated release notes with QA verification steps and encoder flake mitigation.
deploybot: Promotion executed at 23:10 UTC: canary 10% applied. Monitor: https://dash.redwood/rc/2839001122
deploybot: Canary metrics @+20m: latency +5%, errors unchanged. Advancing to 50%.
deploybot: Promotion to 50% complete.
deploybot: 100% rollout at 23:55 UTC. All checks green, no rollback triggered.
maya: Promoted to prod. Thanks everyone :tada:
oncall_tina: staying oncall for 1h during bake.
luca: filed follow-up ticket for perf tuning: INF-2742 (assign:sre).
